rss: Kids eat free and loyalty points - six ways to eat out but not break the bank
title: How to Save Money on Pizza Night
story: Eating out can be fun, but it can also be expensive. Some pizza places offer deals like free pizza for kids or points you can collect for discounts. This way, families can enjoy pizza without spending too much.
storyBig: With rising costs, dining out has become more expensive. To attract families, pizza joints are offering promotions such as 'kids eat free' nights and loyalty programs that reward frequent customers with discounts. These strategies help to increase customer visits while keeping budgets in check.
think: What other ways can stores encourage families to come back?
bull: You get to enjoy more pizza for less money!
bear: Remember to check if the deal is really saving you money.

rss: Will self-flying planes transform the skies?
title: Drones Taking Over the Skies!
story: Self-flying drones are becoming popular for doing jobs like spraying crops. These drones don't need pilots, which can make things faster and easier.
storyBig: The new wave of autonomous drones is revolutionizing the skies, particularly in agriculture. These drones are capable of performing tasks such as crop spraying without the need for human pilots, leading to increased efficiency and reduced labor costs.
think: How do you think drones can help people in other jobs?
bull: Drones can do important jobs and make work easier.
bear: What happens if a drone makes a mistake?
